clue.text: Typical of a girl taking Latin

parts.note: Norma is a girl's name

explanation.surface: Something said to be characteristic of a girl who has signed up for Latin lessons.
explanation.definitionFit: Something typical is ordinary and usual, conforming to the standard pattern.

clue.text: Make final now Linda's abroad

indicators.note: abroad means scattered widely, so the letters are spread about

parts.note: the 's only shows possession or stands for 'is', so it adds no letters: the word before it gives these letters as it is written

explanation.surface: Linda has gone overseas at this moment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'abroad' turns NOW LINDA into NAILDOWN; 'Linda's' is Linda is.
explanation.definitionFit: To nail down an agreement is to settle it definitively.

clue.text: Reserve prop rings coach

indicators.note: rings says one piece encircles the other

parts.note: a rest is a support or prop
to train someone is to coach them

explanation.surface: A rugby prop forward surrounds the trainer.
explanation.walkthrough: A prop is a rugby front-row forward, which makes the surface sound sporting.
explanation.definitionFit: Restraint is self-control, holding back as in reserve of manner.

clue.text: Keen for prima donna to turn up

indicators.note: turn up in a down clue says the word reads from bottom to top

parts.note: a diva is a prima donna

explanation.surface: Eager for the leading soprano to arrive.
explanation.definitionFit: Avid means eager or enthusiastic.

clue.text: Reserve the best for dessert

parts.note: ice means cold reserve, a chilly formality of manner
the cream is the best part of anything, as in the cream of the crop

explanation.surface: Advice to keep the finest course back until the end of the meal.
explanation.definitionFit: A frozen sweet made from dairy is a classic pudding served at the end of a meal.

clue.text: Pop singer loves having time for a cigar

parts.note: Cher is the American pop singer
love is zero in tennis, and O is zero, so two loves are OO

explanation.surface: A singer takes a break for a smoke.
explanation.definitionFit: A cheroot is a cigar with both ends cut square.

clue.text: A dramatisation of the nativity may be very easy to do

definitions.meaning: a nativity play is performed by and about a child
an idiom for a simple task

explanation.surface: A school nativity is said to be a doddle.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means something simple, and literally a drama about a baby.

clue.text: English artist in contact with a source of inspiration

parts.note: RA is a Royal Academician, an artist
to means touching or in contact, as in face to face

explanation.surface: An English painter who touches a fount of creativity.
explanation.definitionFit: Erato is the Greek Muse of lyric poetry, and the Muses inspire.

clue.text: Unwillingness to speak of mother without it getting back to son

indicators.note: without means outside, so the word for mother is wrapped round the rest

parts.note: mum is mother

indicators.note: getting back says the word it is read in reverse

explanation.surface: A mother refuses to talk about it to avoid it reaching her son.
explanation.walkthrough: 'getting back' turns IT into TI, and 'without' places MUM outside TI plus S.
explanation.definitionFit: Mutism is the condition of not speaking, whether by choice or not.

clue.text: Impressive to find gold and a bit of silver in capsized boat

parts.note: Au is the chemical symbol for gold

indicators.note: in says the letter goes inside the boat
capsized in a down clue says the word is turned upside down

parts.note: a tug is a boat

indicators.note: a bit of a word is its first letter here

explanation.surface: Finding treasure in an overturned vessel would be grand.
explanation.walkthrough: 'capsized' turns TUG into GUT, and 'in' puts S, from 'a bit of silver', inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: August means dignified and majestic, inspiring respect.

clue.text: It isn't different inside a Native American people's college

indicators.note: inside says the first word sits within the letters built from the rest
different says the letters of the word after it are made different, rearranged

parts.note: the Ute are a Native American people of Utah and Colorado
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone insists a tribal college is no different on the inside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'It isn't' looks like one anagram, but only 'isn't' is rearranged; 'It' stays whole and slips inside. The Ute are a people of Utah.
explanation.definitionFit: An institute is an organisation for education or research, much like a college.

clue.text: It's not appropriate for Peto to sleep with model

parts.note: Peto is the setter, who refers to themself as I
to nap is to sleep briefly
the Model T is the famous early Ford car

explanation.surface: The setter claims it would be unsuitable for them to go to bed with a fashion model.
explanation.walkthrough: A setter naming themself in a clue usually stands for I or ME.
explanation.definitionFit: Inapt means unsuitable or ill-fitting, the opposite of apt.

clue.text: Essential to end Aretha's challenge

indicators.note: Essential to says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A dare that is vital to the finale of Aretha Franklin's act.
explanation.definitionFit: A dare is a challenge to do something bold or risky.

clue.text: On the outskirts of Omaruru wasted food rots in the open air

indicators.note: the outskirts of a word are its first and last letters
wasted says the letters of the words after it are spoiled and jumbled

explanation.surface: Around the edge of a Namibian town, spoiled food is left rotting outdoors.
explanation.walkthrough: Omaruru is a town in Namibia; its outer letters give OU, and 'wasted' turns FOOD ROTS into TOFDOORS.
explanation.definitionFit: Out-of-doors means outside, under the sky rather than in a building.

clue.text: What dermatologists may do when they occur without warning

definitions.text: What dermatologists may do when they occur without warning

parts.words: What dermatologists may do when they occur without warning
parts.note: skin doctors examine blemishes, and inspections made unannounced share the name

explanation.surface: Skin doctors examining blemishes the moment they appear.
explanation.definitionFit: Random inspections done without notice are named for checking pimples or blemishes.

clue.text: Steal Pat's dog

parts.note: to whip is informal British for to steal or nick
to pat is to pet or stroke an animal

explanation.surface: Someone makes off with Pat's dog.
explanation.definitionFit: A whippet is a slender racing dog bred from greyhounds.

clue.text: Upset by malicious woman's game

parts.note: to tip is to upset or overturn something
a cat is a spiteful, catty woman

explanation.surface: Someone is distressed by a spiteful woman's sport.
explanation.walkthrough: Tipcat is an old street game in which a short tapered stick is struck so it flies up and is hit again.
explanation.definitionFit: Tipcat is a traditional children's pastime played with sticks, a kind of game.

clue.text: Volunteers uplifted by a statement showing respect for property

indicators.note: uplifted in a down clue says the word reads upwards

parts.note: the TA, the Territorial Army, is Britain's volunteer reserve force
a tribute is an act or statement of homage

explanation.surface: Reservists are moved by a speech honouring possessions.
explanation.definitionFit: An attribute is a quality or characteristic, one sense of property.

clue.text: Makes a claim about nurses under pressure

indicators.note: under in a down clue places the earlier pieces beneath the pressure symbol, so it is written first

parts.note: P is the physics symbol for pressure
re means about or concerning
to tend is to nurse

explanation.surface: Someone asserts things about nurses working under stress.
explanation.definitionFit: To pretend is to claim falsely, or to lay claim, as a pretender to a throne.

clue.text: Tasteless jewellery pocketed by South American of high rank

indicators.note: pocketed by says the piece before is held inside the pieces after

parts.note: US means American
tat is cheap tasteless stuff, including trinkets

explanation.surface: Gaudy trinkets slipped into the pocket of a South American bigwig.
explanation.definitionFit: Status is standing or position, especially an elevated one in society.

clue.text: Suffer as Tunis is destroyed

indicators.note: destroyed means broken up, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: People endure hardship as the Tunisian capital is ruined.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is destroyed' turns AS TUNIS into SUSTAIN.
explanation.definitionFit: To sustain a loss is to suffer or undergo it.

clue.text: Talk idly about her taking in a race

parts.note: C stands for circa, Latin for about

indicators.note: taking in says one piece swallows the other

parts.note: taken as written
the TT is the Tourist Trophy motorcycle race on the Isle of Man

explanation.surface: Gossiping about a woman who goes off to watch a race.
explanation.definitionFit: To chatter is to prattle on about trivial matters.

clue.text: Done by a number of people in public

definitions.text: Done by a number of people

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both shared by many and belonging to the community at large.

clue.text: Athletes do it in battle over money at university

parts.note: war is battle
M is the abbreviation for money, as in M1 and M3
up means at university, as in up at Oxford

explanation.surface: Sportspeople fighting over cash while students.
explanation.walkthrough: 'over' in a down clue puts WAR above M.
explanation.definitionFit: A warm-up is the preparatory exercise athletes perform before competing.

clue.text: Everybody hates me dithering even so

parts.note: all means everybody

indicators.note: dithering suggests the letters are unsettled and rearranged

explanation.surface: A complaint that everyone despises the speaker, yet nothing changes.
explanation.definitionFit: All the same is an idiom meaning nevertheless or regardless.

clue.text: Nationalist breaks Spike's weapon

indicators.note: breaks says one piece splits the other open

parts.note: to lace a drink is to spike it

explanation.surface: A nationalist breaks someone named Spike's weapon.
explanation.definitionFit: A lance is a long spear carried by mounted knights.

clue.text: Come to an end before the opening of parliament

parts.note: to die is to come to an end

indicators.note: the opening of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A session finishes just before the State Opening of Parliament.
explanation.walkthrough: The State Opening of Parliament is the British ceremony starting a session; here 'the opening' gives only T.
explanation.definitionFit: A diet is a legislative assembly, as in Japan's Diet or the Holy Roman Empire's.

clue.text: Passage from Amiss targeting a leading performer

indicators.note: Passage from says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A section from a wayward attack aimed at a headline act.
explanation.definitionFit: A star is the principal actor or singer in a show.

clue.text: Niece oddly neglected after servant becomes deranged

parts.note: a man is a manservant

indicators.note: the odd-numbered letters are passed over, keeping the even ones

explanation.surface: A niece is ignored after the help goes mad.
explanation.definitionFit: Manic means wild and frenzied, mentally unbalanced.

clue.text: A complete change of opinion on the subject of spin

parts.note: about means concerning or on the subject of
a turn is a spin or rotation

explanation.surface: A total U-turn in someone's thinking about rotation.
explanation.definitionFit: An about-turn is a reversal of policy or view, from the military drill of facing the other way.

clue.text: Good-humoured requests by a social worker

parts.note: pleas are earnest requests
an ant is a social insect and a worker

explanation.surface: A cheerful set of appeals from someone in social services.
explanation.walkthrough: 'social worker' sounds like a care professional, but ants are social insects with worker castes.
explanation.definitionFit: Pleasant means agreeable and friendly in manner.

clue.text: Orders small underwear

definitions.meaning: instructions given to someone, such as a barrister or a soldier

explanation.surface: Someone buys skimpy pants.
explanation.definitionFit: The word covers both sets of instructions issued and short close-fitting undergarments.
